title: Digital OOH
slide_intent: Teach how a short line can communicate at outdoor viewing distance while a photograph supplies the sensory appeal.
strategic_value: The repeated phrase can turn a tap on a device into anticipation of eating, connecting shopping with savoring in one composition.
demonstration: A photographed billboard divides a dark green type field from a portrait of a person enjoying food. The signature sits beneath the large tap tap / nom nom line.
practical_value: Test whether the short line and portrait still read at distance, then size the signature to identify the advertiser without competing with them.

content_islands.name: Outdoor frame
content_islands.spec: Show the whole billboard within its surroundings so the viewing context remains apparent.

content_islands.name: Message and portrait
content_islands.spec: Divide the board into two nearly equal fields. Set the short line large above a small signature at left and let the portrait fill the right.
